mission: Independently propose the smallest playable experiment that tests whether the signature feature creates a second layer of decisions.
decision_authority: You may choose slot counts, timing, costs and trigger rules for this prototype only. You may not change the owner invariants.
non_goals: Do not assume the nested variant is required.
allowed_context: The stage question for P1. No competing proposal and no director preference.
evidence_required: A measurement plan, with kill criteria written before any result exists
output_contract: Return: hypothesis, minimal rules, interaction flow, expected moment of insight, failure cases, evidence plan, kill criteria.
stop_condition: Stop once a testable proposal exists. Do not expand into content production.
